answer: Bind each identity to a scarce, verifiable stake and slash it on misbehavior. To mine, an identity locks a bond — as hard to counterfeit as a quartz crystal and as costly to forfeit as carved jade — and a public beacon timestamps the lock so it cannot be backdated. Spawning a thousand sybils now means posting a thousand real bonds; any caught cross-grading or forging loses its stake. Capital at risk, not free identities, sets the price of attack.
